title: Separate a logarithmic common cleanup clock from irreversible site-specific injury
statement: For independent cleavageu, per-tag fatal competingh and whole-product damaged, G_L(t)=exp(-dt)[u/(u+h)*(1-exp(-(u+h)t))]^L. For d>0 the optimum is log(1+L(u+h)/d)/(u+h). Withh0 and fixedeps=d/u the optimized loss is polynomial inL; per-tag injury restores[u/(u+h)]^L.

body: The derivative gives the exact shared-time optimum. For d0 the best value is a limiting supremum, not a finite optimal time. This does not establish accessible linkers, chemical compatibility or observed traceless removal. Harmless tag disposal is different from permanent peptide injury, and all final cleanup/production costs remain paid.
